'''Doo Zuto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] crew member of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Woebegone]]''.

==Biography==
As Zuto Doo and his comrades set out on a journey to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] from [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]], they realized that a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] was hiding as a stowaway on the ''[[Woebegone]]''. Upon debate, the crew decided to drop out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and contact Bal'demnic authorities to see if the Muun was on the wanted list. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], who was in actuality the Muun stowaway, attacked the crew as he wanted to preserve the privacy of his affairs on Bal'demnic. Zuto Doo was killed during the fight with [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis.
